resources.string: Wrong code. Check the 6-digit code on the PC and try again.
The PC is not available: it is offline, its internet access is off, or it has no active code.
The PC did not respond in time. Check that ReyDesk is open on the PC.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
The connection was declined on the PC.
The code has expired. Create a new one on the PC.
The codes were not confirmed as the same.
Code comparison is paused after failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
This phone is not connected to the ReyDesk server. Turn on internet access in Settings.
Cannot reach the PC on this network. Turn on internet access on both devices to connect from anywhere.
This QR code or pairing code has expired or was already used. Create a new one on the PC.
This QR code was already used. Click Generate new code on the PC and scan the new code.
